subject.title: fix(release): bind npm publishing to approved package bytes

question: Is exact-head non-publishing Testbox coverage sufficient for this release-boundary change once the PR body cites the correct run, or is a controlled live publish exercise required before merge?
rationale: The implementation is correct and intentionally avoids irreversible publication during development, but only a release owner can accept the residual gap between comprehensive simulated validation and a real OIDC npm promotion.

options.title: Accept exact-head non-publishing proof
options.body: Require the PR body to cite run 29129847790, then accept its focused release tests, workflow validation, and security checks as sufficient pre-merge proof.

options.title: Require controlled live publish proof
options.body: Pause merge until a release owner exercises the path through an approved disposable or prerelease publication and records registry readback evidence.

recommendation.title: Accept exact-head non-publishing proof
recommendation.body: Require the PR body to cite run 29129847790, then accept its focused release tests, workflow validation, and security checks as sufficient pre-merge proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main and branch history ties this person directly to the release evidence and publication boundary being changed.
